description:
Why a piece's story is where it is on the list: its rank and score, the mains at the edition's home and at
the world, the pulls that lifted it (each stake the edition holds, its step, the main it read and its part of
the score, with the arithmetic), the gates that cut a main (no outlet abroad told it, a routine notice), who
carried it, who it is about, what is just above and below, and what near it was left out and why.
name: why
title: Why it is here
